string.name: steps_qq_auth
string.value:
① Login to QQ/Foxmail webmail using "Open Webmail".
② Go to "Settings → Account", enable IMAP/SMTP service.
③ Generate "Authorization Code" and copy it, then click "Paste" on this page.

string.name: steps_163_auth
string.value:
① Login to 163/126/188 webmail, go to "Settings → POP3/SMTP/IMAP".
② Enable IMAP/SMTP and set Client Authorization Password.
③ Copy the password and paste it on this page.

string.name: steps_gmail_auth
string.value:
① Login to Google Account → Security, enable "2-Step Verification".
② Search and enter "App Passwords", generate a 16-digit password.
③ Paste this password on this page (this becomes your IMAP password).

string.name: steps_outlook_auth
string.value:
① Login to account.microsoft.com or Outlook web, enable "Two-step Verification".
② Create "App Password" in Security info.
③ Paste the generated password on this page.

string.name: steps_custom_auth
string.value:
① Login to your webmail in browser.
② Look for "App Password" or "Auth Code" in Settings/Client/IMAP.
③ Generate and copy to paste on this page.

string.name: steps_default_auth
string.value:
① Login to webmail, enable IMAP/SMTP in settings.
② Find and generate "Client Authorization Code / App Password".
③ Copy and paste or enter manually on this page.
